description:
Whether you're a beginner learning openings or a tournament player preparing for your next opponent, Chess.ceo gives you professional chess analysis tools right on your phone.

Engine Analysis

Analyze any position with Stockfish, the world's strongest chess engine, running locally on your device, no internet required.

Need more power? Cloud Engines let you run analysis on a dedicated cloud machine, billed per minute and only while it's running.

14M Game Database

Explore over 14 million master-level games with real-time opening statistics. For any position, instantly see which moves were played, how often they led to wins, and at what rating level. Filter by rating range and time control to find data relevant to your level. Endgame positions are covered by seven-piece Syzygy tablebases showing perfect play with distance-to-mate.

Opponent Preparation

Search any player by name, country, or FIDE title. View their game history, ratings, and most-played openings. Study their repertoire and identify weaknesses before your next tournament game. Link players across FIDE, Lichess and Chess.com profiles.

Live Tournament Broadcasts

Follow ongoing tournaments with live game boards, per-board evaluation bars, and live standings. Jump straight into any player's games while a round is in progress.

Full Game Analysis

Import games via PGN, paste from clipboard or load from file. The engine evaluates every move and shows where mistakes were made. Build a complete variation tree with main lines and sidelines, annotate key moments, and save your analysis for later.

PGN Files

Organize your analyzed games into files and folders, synced across devices when you sign in. Import hundreds of games at once, or export to share with coaches and training partners.

Additional Features

• Chess960 (Fischer Random) with one tap

• Chess clock with customizable time controls

• Position editor for setting up any position

• Search games by position across your files

• Landscape and tablet support

• Seven languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Russian, Chinese, and Arabic

Free to Use

All of the above is free, no ads. Create an account and start analyzing.

CEO Tier: Optional Subscription

For players who want more:

• Pro Board: full-screen, distraction-free analysis

• Full database offline: all 10 million games on your device, no connection needed

• Higher daily limits on search, preparation, and database queries

• More storage for your PGN files

Subscribe monthly, cancel any time.

description:
GameParty is made for Indian users who want a place to talk, play, and meet people with similar social interests. It brings voice rooms and casual party activities into one Android app, so users can spend time with friends or speak with new people from India and Indian communities abroad. For users looking to download GameParty, the app is mainly about group interaction, live conversation, and community based entertainment in a familiar social setting.


GameParty Features

Party games in one place

GameParty includes several casual games that fit group voice rooms and social play. You can find games such as Mic Grab, Who’s the Spy, Ludo, Carrom, UMO, Domino, and Jackaroo. Since these games are available inside the same app, players can move between different room activities without changing platforms.

Voice rooms for Indian communities

GameParty lets you join voice chat rooms that stay active through the day. These rooms are designed for Indians in India as well as Indians living abroad, which makes the app useful for people who want to speak in a familiar social space. In addition, the room format supports casual chats, group games, and community gatherings.

Social party formats

You can take part in different room styles based on the mood of the group. GameParty supports Mic Grab, singing competitions, gossip chats, birthday parties, wedding themed rooms, and game rooms. These formats help users choose between simple conversation, performance based interaction, or group play.

Gift animations and profile expression

GameParty includes animated gifts, India themed gifts, luxury car effects, and avatar frames. You can use these items to support friends, react during voice rooms, or show your style in a social setting. The feature is mainly tied to interaction inside rooms, so it works as part of the live community experience.

Family and level systems

GameParty has a Global Family feature where Indian communities can gather, help each other, and take part for family honor. The app also includes VIP, SVIP, user level, couple level, and family level systems. These elements give regular users more social roles and rewards inside the app environment.


What to Know About GameParty

GameParty Play Game & Chat is focused on live voice based interaction, so the experience depends on joining rooms and speaking with other users. If you prefer solo games without social contact, this app may not match your main purpose. However, if you want games, voice chat, and Indian community rooms in one place, the GameParty app gives a clear social structure.

The app also highlights a safe and comfortable environment, women’s safety and support, CP marriage, and 24 hour customer service as part of its social experience. These points matter because voice rooms involve real people and live communication. Before using GameParty Android, users should choose rooms carefully and follow the rules of each room to keep conversations respectful.


How to Use GameParty on Android

After installing the GameParty APK, you can start by entering the app and choosing the type of room or game that fits your mood. The process is simple because most activities are built around joining a room, listening, speaking, and playing with others.

  1. Open GameParty on your Android phone and sign in or create an account if the app asks for one.
  2. Browse the available voice rooms, then choose a room based on games, singing, chat, birthday themes, or wedding themes.
  3. Join the room and listen first, so you can understand the room topic, host style, and current activity.
  4. Take part by speaking on mic, joining a game such as Ludo or Mic Grab, or sending gifts when you want to react to friends.
  5. Use family, level, couple, VIP, or SVIP features if you want to stay active in the same community over time.


Get Started with GameParty

GameParty brings voice rooms, party games, Indian community themes, gifts, and family style social features into one Android app. Users who want the GameParty latest version can use APKPure to access the app page and check the available APK details before downloading.

description:
Nature is a digital board game that invites you into the untamed wilderness, where you must adapt to survive. From the designer of the award-winning Evolution series, Nature is designed to be faster, better balanced, and seamlessly expandable.

Adapt to Survive

Grow your creatures in a world where resources are limited and danger is never far away. Develop the Fast trait to outrun predators, add Nesting to boost your population growth, or play Scavenger to gain food after predators attack. With traits that combine and synergize, you can create unique combinations and find success with a variety of strategies.

Mix and Match Modules

Thanks to Nature's modular game system, no two games are ever the same. Each Module introduces new rules and thematic twists to the ecosystem. Flight features soaring creatures and new ways to find food, Jurassic brings out colossal predators, and in the Arctic Tundra survival itself is always in question. Modules can even be combined to create new ecosystems.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Nature has been refined through years of development and thousands of playtests to offer a game that's easy to learn yet deep in strategy. New players can jump right in with clear rules and intuitive gameplay, while experienced strategists will discover layers of tactical depth and challenge, even more so as the Modules as added in. The result is a well-balanced experience with depth and variety for endless replay value.

Key Features:

Solo Campaign: Play against smart digital opponents and take on custom challenges that tweak the rules in the Campaign.

Multiplayer Matchmaking: Get matched with others of a similar skill level in cross platform multiplayer.

Play with friends your way: Challenge friends in real time or asynchronous games, or use pass and play for up to four players on the same device.

Singleplayer Opponents: Four levels of AI difficulty and six different opponent strategies provide lots of challenge.

Stunning Artwork: Beautiful watercolor illustrations and animations bring the natural world to life.

Endless Replayability: Each game unfolds in a fresh ecosystem with new strategic opportunities.

Whether you venture alone or with fellow explorers, the wilds of Nature offer a new adventure with every visit.

description:
Pente Live lets you play turn-based and live games at your beloved pente.org. No longer are you bound to your computer to play pente against other players. This app supports *all* games available at pente.org. Available for both Android and iOS.

Pente is a board game that is easy to learn, difficult to master. Compete with players all over the world on a 19x19 board. There is

- turn-based play,

- realtime (live) play,

- play against 2 different computer players,

- participate in tournaments,

- play King of the Hill and earn a crown,

- search the game database by position for the most popular or best move!

Gomoku: To win, place 5 (not more) of your stones in a straight continuous line (either horizontally, vertically or diagonally).

Pente is like Gomoku but you can win by getting more than 5 in a row.

In Pente you can capture stones by enclosing a pair of your opponent's stones. For example, if the stones are like this XOO and you place your stone so it becomes XOOX, then your opponents' stones are removed from the board, leaving X__X. You can also win at Pente by capturing 10 or more of your opponents stones. You can't play into a capture.

Rated games have a "Tournament Rule". It restricts player 1's second move so that player 1's second move must be at least 3 intersections away from the center of the board.

Keryo-Pente is like Pente but you can also capture 3 stones in a row.

G-Pente restricts player 1's second move, like the tournament rule. It additionally prohibits playing on the 4th and 5th intersections away from the center of the board that are one the same horizontal or vertical line as player 1's first move. (These are the most common 2nd moves for white).

D-Pente: Player 1 places 2 white and 2 black stones as a first move. Then player 2 decides to continue playing as player 2, or decides to swap seats and take over as player 1! Afterwards, play continues like regular Pente.

Poof-Pente: The main difference is that you can play into a capture! (e.g., from XO_X player plays XOOX) then the stones are "poofed" (removed from the board and counted as captures). Normal captures are still allowed and the number of captures to win remains at 10 stones. Up to 5 stones could be poofed in one move! Also note that my current implementation performs the following actions in sequence after a move:

Check if move captured any opponents stones, if so remove stones from the board.

Check if move creates a poof position, if so remove stones from the board.

Check if player has a 5-in-a-row, if so the player wins.

A player could capture and be poofed in the same move and the capture count could end up as 10-10. The game keeps going until one player has an advantage (i.e., gets more captured stones or gets five-in-a-row). There are no draws.

Boat-Pente differs in the end game. Once a Pente is made (5 stones in a row), the game continues as long as the opponent is able to capture across the Pente! Capturing 5 pairs is still a win like in Pente and the tournament rule is used for rated games.

Connect6: The goal is to be the first player to get 6 pieces in a row, either vertically, horizontally or diagonally. Player one plays one stone at the center of the board. After that each player gets to place two stones on the board at a time.

DK-Pente combines the rules of D-Pente and Keryo-Pente.

Go is also available

Kifu Master brings over 180,000 professional Go (baduk / weiqi / igo) games to your phone — searchable by player, event and year, with player names unified across English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Review pro games, test yourself by playing them from memory, and record and manage your own games as SGF files.

PROFESSIONAL GAME DATABASE

Regularly updated with new games, the archive covers the great title tournaments of Japan, Korea and China — Honinbo, Meijin, Kisei — international events like the LG Cup and Samsung Cup, and historical classics going back centuries. It is far more than an unsorted collection: fast filters take you straight to the games you want, from Shin Jinseo, Ke Jie, Lee Sedol, Iyama Yuta and Cho Chikun to classics like Go Seigen and Honinbo Shusaku.

ONE PLAYER, ONE NAME

Player names are unified across languages and romanizations: "Lee Changho", "Yi Ch'ang-ho" and "이창호" all lead to the same player and the same set of games. Inconsistent spellings of Chinese, Japanese and Korean names are normalized automatically, so you never miss a game because of how a name was written.

PLAY FROM MEMORY

Think you know a game by heart? Play the moves yourself on the board. Each correct move keeps the game going, and your statistics track how many moves of each game you have memorized.

PERSONAL LIBRARY

Record your own games as they happen and keep them all in one place.

- Import & export: Save games as SGF or PNG, and open SGF files from outside the app.

- Organized archive: "Favorites" and "Recent" take you back to any game instantly.

- Offline access: Review downloaded games even without an internet connection.

ADVANCED SGF VIEWER

Kifu Master pairs the elegant SGF viewer of the Sabaki ecosystem with a vast Go archive, and adds features of its own: adjustable-speed autoplay, optional board coordinates, and board themes including Ayvalık, Kimchi, Sakura and Dao.

ANDROID TV

Kifu Master also runs on Android TV and Google TV with a clean, remote-friendly interface. Open the latest pro games and your favorites, and let games autoplay on the big screen — ideal for clubs, lectures and study groups. Sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone; your autoplay speed stays in sync across phone, TV and web.

SIX LANGUAGES

Available in English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian and Turkish.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The free version lets you review the first 6 games you select and add 3 of them to your favorites. If you enjoy Kifu Master, the monthly Premium subscription removes all limits and unlocks every feature.

FEEDBACK

Bug reports, suggestions and feature requests are always welcome — please write to me directly. Kifu Master is built and maintained by a single developer who is also a Go player, so everything you send comes straight to me, and I read all of it. Your ideas may show up in the app sooner than you expect.

Enjoy your games!

— Gote Sensei

description:
Picture Wonders Solitaire is a relaxing picture puzzle where every image is cut in two. Find the matching halves, slide them together and watch the full picture come back to life!

It mixes the calm of solitaire with the joy of a picture puzzle. Drag cards, drop them into place and clear the board one beautiful picture at a time. No timers, no lives, no pressure – just you and a board full of wonders.

HOW TO PLAY

• Every picture is split into two halves: top and bottom, or left and right.

• Drag a card onto another card to swap them.

• Drop a card into an empty space and it falls to the bottom of that column.

• Put the top half right above its bottom half (or the left half right next to its right half) and they merge into the full picture, then disappear.

• Cards above drop down to fill the gap – line up the next pair and keep the combo going!

• Face-down decks above each column deal new cards as space opens up, just like solitaire.

• Clear every card on the board and in the decks to win the level.

FEATURES

• Over 1,500 beautiful pictures: pets, birds, butterflies, oceans, planets, cars, trains, cakes, teacups, vases, toys, flowers and more.

Whether you love solitaire, jigsaw puzzles, matching games or simply beautiful pictures, Picture Wonders Solitaire is your calm little escape. Start your first picture today!

description:
Game of Goose or Royal Game of Goose is ancient board game, variations of rules and illustrative designs makes this game very interesting.

The game is played on a spiral shaped board consisting of 63 spaces. There are six differently coloured Goose. All players start from square 0 and goal is to reach to square 63 before other players to win. All you’ve to do is throw the dices, and move your player. So simple right?

But here is the catch, Goose has different types of square and each square has different rules.

Goose square: If you landed on Goose Square, you’ll repeat the last score again.

Well Square: Well, so avoid it. If you fell into well then you’ll stay in the well until some other player also fell into well to rescue you. He’ll replace you.

Prison Square: Same as well square, you’ve caught in prison. Wait for other player to take your place.

Nest Square: Goose loves nest, their home. Your goose will stay in nest for next three turns.

Maze Square: Go back to square 39.

Skull square: This is most undesirable landing, Go you’ve to go back to square one.

Sound interesting? Yeah its game of luck. You throw the dice and hopes you don’t land on certain type of squares.

----------------------------------------------------------

There are six possible objectives on each level.

1. Score quota

2. Removing dark pulps

3. Bringing down ice cream(s).

4. Removing Net(s)

5. Removing Bee(s)

6. Consume the Star candy.

----------------------------------------------------------

There are two possible challenges on each level.

1. Complete the objective before time runs out.

2. Complete the objective before you ran out of swaps.

----------------------------------------------------------

Obstacles.

1. Cupcakes / Chocolate block: These items can not be moved, can only

be cleared if an adjacent match item is cleared or if an

candy jar or a double candy item power up is triggered.

A chocolate block leaves a level three dark pulp.

2. Netted Candy: A candy behind a net can not be swapped.

Can only be removed by matching the candy behind the net

with two other candies of the same type, or if it's in the

path of a triggered power up chain.

----------------------------------------------------------

Objectives.

1. Score quota - You need to reach a certain score in order to

level up.

2. Remove dark pulps.

Dark pulps are removed be clearing the candy ontop of the

dark pulp. There are three levels of dark pulps. The darkest

pulp needs to be removed three times, which means you need

to clear three candies ontop of that dark pulp.

3. Bring down the ice cream(s).

Bring down ice cream(s) to the bottom of the game board.

4. Free the netted candy.

5. Remove all bees.

There are three bee phases.

6. Consume the star candy.

----------------------------------------------------------

A vaulted candy when opened reveals the star candy.

A vaulted candy can only be opened by matching and clearing

all the keyed candies.

----------------------------------------------------------

Bee(s) are not switchable and can

not be swapped.

You need to match an adjacent candy around the

bee to change its phase

In order to remove a bee, the bee needs to

cycle to all the phases, from enclosed sleeping bee to

open winged bee.

All bees(s) needs to be removed in order to

level up.

----------------------------------------------------------

Matching 4 or more candies rewards the player

with a power up candy.

There are three power ups.

1. Candy jar (horizontal and vertical).

2. Double candy.

3. Lollipop.

----------------------------------------------------------

Mystery items.

Mystery items are represented by wrapped candies.

Mystery items are unraveled by matching the mystery item's color

with the candy color. Mystery items could be power ups or an

obstacle - making the level easier or harder it's up to your

luck

----------------------------------------------------------

description:
Wallkade is a Wall Rush game that brings classic Quoridor to your phone as a fast wall rush 1v1 battle. Move your pawn, place walls to block the way and send your opponent the wrong way. First to reach the other side wins.

WHAT IS WALLKADE?

A wall rush game on a 9×9 board. Every turn you decide what to do: wall or step. You start with ten walls, and each wall block makes your rival's path longer. You can never shut the road completely, so the real skill is a smart barricade that turns a short route into a long detour. Fans of wallrush, Wallz and wayblock games will feel right at home: Wallkade is the wall block app built for fast online matches.

GAME MODES

- Online Wall Rush 1v1: real opponents, matches take just a few minutes

- Ranked wallrush: Bullet, Blitz and Rapid, each with its own rating and leaderboard

- Friends: challenge friends to a private wall rush game

- Vs computer: the wall block app works offline, with an AI from easy to hard

- Pass and play: 2 player Quoridor game on one device

- 4 players: four pawns, four sides, one big wallrush

QUORIDOR RULES IN ONE MINUTE

1. Each player has a pawn and ten walls.

2. On your turn, move one square or place one wall.

3. A wall is two squares long and blocks movement between squares, but a path to the goal must always stay open.

4. If your opponent stands right next to you, jump over them.

5. Reach the opposite side first and the wallrush is yours.

HOW TO WIN MORE

- Save walls for the endgame: late walls decide close races

- Lead your opponent the wrong way, then close the gap behind them

- Count both paths before every move: the shorter path wins

- One wall block in the right spot beats three random walls

- A way block set early forces a long detour

Wallkade is a free wall block app and Quoridor game for Android phones and tablets, made for players who love Wallz-style wayblock duels. If you enjoy wallrush or any wall rush game where you block the way and race to the finish, download Wallkade and start your first Wall Rush game today.

101 Yuzbir Okey, played by millions since 2000, is now on your phone and tablet! Online play with real players, with NO ADS and completely FREE.

FREE POINT GAMES

You can play as many point games as you want without paying any fee.

EXCITING CREDIT GAMES

If the excitement of point games is not enough for you, we have credit games. Moreover, free bonus credits every day, enough to play dozens of games.

GAMING EXPERIENCE AT ITS BEST

In the games we have prepared with years of experience, everything is where it should be, in the right dosage, neither more nor less. The widest meld area, assisted and doubling games, automatic tile sorting buttons, hand opening buttons. Rearranging opened tiles and forming new sets from them, found in no other 101 game, is only in our 101 Yuzbir Okey app. Our aim is for you to have fun and to live the best 101 experience in our application.

VOICE CHAT

Playing and typing at the same time is hard; now you can call your friends and chat while playing...

CHAT AND FRIENDSHIP

You can meet new people, chat and make friends. You can play cooperative games with your friends. Lobby, table and private chats are right at your fingertips. If you wish, you can easily write your messages by dictation without using the keyboard. With premium services, you can customize your membership and stand out.

GAME WORLD - GAMYUN

The features or credits you get are valid in all our tile/card games, whether you play from your computer, phone or tablet. You don't have to buy separate features and credits for each game.

PRIVACY MATTERS

You use nicknames in our games; even if you connect with Facebook, your name or photo will not be visible.

HOW TO PLAY 101 YUZBIR OKEY?

In 101, the goal is to form sets with the tiles in your hand and open them on the table. You can open series sets when the total value of your sets is 101, or pair sets when you have 5 pairs.

Each hand, 21 tiles are dealt to every player. The player who goes first receives one extra tile and plays the first turn by discarding a tile without drawing. Players try either to reach 101 with series or to reach 5 pairs. Series sets consist of consecutive numbers (1 2 3 - 7 8 9 - 11 12 13) or the same number in different colors (Blue 11 - Yellow 11 - Red 11). Unlike in Okey, the 12-13-1 set is invalid in 101.

After opening your hand, when it is your turn you can also add tiles from your hand to the sets on the table, and if someone has opened pairs, you can open the pairs in your hand. A player who opened series can also open any new set they form. A player who opened pairs cannot open series sets, but if someone has opened series, they can add tiles from their hand to the sets, at most 2 tiles to the right and left of each set per turn, or open new pairs from their hand. Adding tiles works like this: if there is a red 1-2-3 set on the table, you can attach the red 4 and 5 from your hand to it.

Discarding a tile that could be added to a set to the next player costs a 101-point penalty. Similarly, opening an invalid hand requires taking the tiles back and carries a 101-point penalty.

THANKS FOR CHOOSING US

If you like our application, you will make us happy if you take a moment and write a positive review. Thanks in advance... You can send your suggestions, requests and complaints to destek at gamyun.net, or reach us through the in-game support section.

description:
The table is set

In the Caribbean, dominoes isn't a pastime. It's a conversation. It gets played outside the corner store, under the carport, at the end of a meal nobody wants to end. DR Dominoes brings that table to your screen: same rules, same tension, same people. Even if they're three thousand miles away.

Tiles in 3D with real weight, real light, real sound. A table you can read at a glance. No endless menus. Just you, your partner, and seven tiles.

The table talks

Dominoes is won with your hand and played with your mouth. This isn't flat voice chat where everybody comes through the same channel at the same volume. This is a table — and at a table, everybody has a chair.

Proximity voice chat: you hear every player from where they're sitting. Your partner, across from you. The one about to lock up the table, on your left. You hear him coming.

Text chat: for when you don't want the mic on — or when the comment deserves to be in writing.

The table sounds like a table: the slap of a tile on wood, the guy complaining, and the one who already knows what's coming and hasn't said a word.

House rules

Double-six set. 28 tiles. Four players, two teams.

No boneyard, no drawing. Seven tiles each — you play what you were dealt, or you pass.

Leads, passes, blocked games, capicúas. The whole vocabulary, nothing trimmed.

Games to 100, 120, 150 or 200 points. You decide whether it's a quick round or a war.

The chain turns the corner when it runs out of table, just like the real thing. No tiles wandering off into nowhere.

Get a game going

Offline mode: the full table against the AI. No internet, no excuses.

Private rooms: share a code and everybody's seated in seconds.

Room browser: drop into a public table that's still filling up.

Reconnect: if your connection drops, your chair is still there.

Stats: your profile keeps count. Wins, blocks, win rate — everything you'll need the next time somebody doubts you.

When nobody's around

The AI in DR Dominoes isn't there to fill seats. It counts tiles, remembers what you passed on, and locks up the table when you least expect it. Use it to practice, to round out a partnership, or just to play in peace on a Sunday afternoon.

Pull up a chair. Shuffle. And don't get caught holding the double six.

description:
Sungka is the classic Filipino mancala board game: two rows of seven houses, one ulo each, and shells sown counter-clockwise until the last one lands. Play it online with players anywhere, or offline: against the computer, with a friend on one phone, or at a table on your WiFi.

TWENTY-SIX GAMES, ONE BOARD

It opens on the game your language or country knows, and any other is a tap away.

• Sungka as it is played, both opening at once, or in turns with a coin toss.

• Congklak (congkak, congka): the same game sown clockwise, in its own words.

• Mancala (kalah, kalaha, bantumi), six houses of four; Mancala Basic, Japan's race to empty your side; and Dakon, Java's five of five.

• Ohvalhu (naranj), the Maldives' eight holes of eight cowries.

• Pallanguzhi (pallankuli), Tamil Nadu's seven holes of six cowries.

• Ô ăn quan (ô quan), Vietnam's five squares a side with a big one at each end that is nobody's, and Bày khòm, Cambodia's ten houses in an oval: sown either way, and a capture goes on.

• Oware (awalé, wari), Warri, Wahree and the Bohnenspiel: no store is sown, and a count takes.

• Mangala from Turkey, and Toguz kumalak (toguz korgool), Central Asia's nine holes of nine, where three makes a hole yours.

• Gebeta (gabata), three rows of six from Eritrea and Ethiopia: both open at once, and a capture takes the file across.

• Four rows, each player sowing round their own two: Hawalis (bao kiarabu) from Oman and Hus (otjitoto) from Namibia, where a capture takes the hole across and the one behind it; Moruba from South Africa and Tshuba from Mozambique, where it takes one more you pick besides; Omweso (mweso) from Uganda, laid out by its players; and Bao la kujifunza, East Africa's bao for beginners.

• Or set your own: houses a side, shells a house, laps, captures.

THE REAL RULES

• Sabog capture: land in an empty house of yours and take everything across from it.

• Extra turn when your last shell drops into your own ulo.

• Chains: land on shells and keep sowing.

• Play in turns, with a coin toss for the opener, or the traditional opening where both players start at once.

• Burnt houses, stranded shells and an optional match clock. Every rule is a switch.

FIVE COMPUTER LEVELS

From Baguntao, who is still learning, to Katas, who counts every shell. The computer's hand shows as a ghost so you can follow each move, and the top level will point at the best sow when you ask.

PLAY ONLINE

A match in any game in seconds, casual or ranked: a rating for each game, leaderboards for the world, your country and your friends, and daily quests. Add friends, invite them to a table, send an emote, play for coins. Or play offline: pass and play on one phone, or host a table on your WiFi, no account needed.

LEARN AND IMPROVE

Short lessons on a live board, for whichever game you pick: the board, sowing, the opening, the capture, extra turns, rounds and the endgame, each on that game's board and in its own words. A daily puzzle for each game. After every match: its turning point, your accuracy against the best sow and your rating.

MADE FOR THE MAT

Narra, kapis, marble, gold and ruby boards; cowries and round beads in kapis, gold, glass and stone; and mats, woven in many colours or floored in gold, jade and ruby, from the board shop. Two themes, Banig by day and Gabi by night. In 27 languages, English, Tagalog and Bisaya among them. Large text and screen reader support.

Collect coins every day you visit, for the day's puzzle, for every win against the computer and for watching an ad whenever you like. Your coins and board-shop items are kept on our server and follow your phone's game account to your other phones and tablets of the same kind, with your lessons and puzzles.

Sungka is played across the Philippines, and the same board is congkak in Malaysia, congklak or dakon in Indonesia, chongka' in the Marianas and kalah in a shop. This is that board, faithfully, in your pocket. Contains ads and in-app purchases. Terms: https://sungka.puhgeh.com/terms/

description:
Scarab scourge

Jewel Drops begins as a simple match three board

game and gradually increases difficulties as obstacles

are added and level objectives becomes more

challenging.

----------------------------------------------------------

* Introducing the Scarab Obstacle

* 300 levels over five difficulty modes including relaxed no timer special.

* Multiple objectives ,challenges and obstacles

* 15 Dazzling power up combinations

* Each level presents you with unique Objectives and Challenges.

* Obstacles mixed with unique level board shapes will keep you swiping and matching for more.

* Create powerful chained power up cascades to level up!

* No in-app purchase, one time payment for the whole gaming experience.

* Hints/Music/Banners can be disabled.

----------------------------------------------------------

There are five possible objectives on each level.

1. Score quota

2. Removing dark pulps

3. Bringing down Crown(s).

4. Removing Net(s)

5. Removing Scarab(s)

There are two possible challenges on each level.

1. Complete the objective before time runs out.

2. Complete the objective before you ran out of swaps.

----------------------------------------------------------

Obstacles.

1. Crook and Flail and Jar: These items can not be moved, can only

be cleared if an adjacent match item is cleared or if an

arrow jewel or a double jewel item power up is triggered.

A jar leaves a level three dark pulp.

2. Netted Jewel: A jewel behind a net can not be swapped.

Can only be removed by matching the jewel behind the net

with two other jewels of the same type, or if it's in the

path of a triggered power up chain.

----------------------------------------------------------

Objectives.

1. Score quota - You need to reach a certain score in order to

level up.

2. Remove dark pulps.

Dark pulps are removed be clearing the jewel ontop of the

dark pulp. There are three levels of dark pulps. The darkest

pulp needs to be removed three times, which means you need

to clear three jewels ontop of that dark pulp.

3. Bring down the crowns.

Bring down the crown to the bottom of the gameboard.

4. Free the netted jewel.

5. Remove all Scarabs.

There are four Scarab phases.

Scarab(s) are not switchable and can not be swapped.

You need to match an adjacent jewel around the

Scarab to change its phase

In order to remove a Scarab, the Scarab needs to

cycle to all the phases, from enclosed sleeping Scarab to

open winged Scarab.

All Scarab(s) needs to be removed in order to

level up.

----------------------------------------------------------

Matching 4 or more jewels rewards the player

with a power up jewel.

There are three power ups.

1. Arrow jewel (horizontal and vertical).

2. Double jewel.

3. Clustered jewel.

----------------------------------------------------------

Mystery items.

Mystery items are unraveled by matching the mystery item's color

with the jewel color. Mystery items could be power ups or an

obstacle - making the level easier or harder; it's up to your

luck

----------------------------------------------------------

Auto hints can be disabled/enabled

Banners can be disabled/enabled

Music and sound can be disabled/enabled

----------------------------------------------------------

Korea(Corea) Traditional Game : Yutnori

* This game is a game made so that you can unfold more diverse strategies by adding items to regular Yutnori.

*This is a game that focuses on strategy using items rather than yut.

In this game, it is more important to place items and where to place them rather than how Yut comes out.

The time to throw Yut was minimized and the game pieces were placed as quickly as possible.

In this game, you can set the number of game pieces as much as your level (levels 1 to 4 can set up to 4 game pieces, and from level 5 or higher, you can set the number of game pieces as many as your level)

*Description of side buttons

1. Mushroom lamp: If you press it after throwing yut, your moveable game pieces will be selected in turn.

2. Sleeper: Advances the selected game piece.

*Basic explanation of general Yutnori:

It is a board game that starts from the starting point, spins around once, and returns to the starting point.

If you reach a fork in the road, you can take a shortcut.

Four yut sticks are thrown and moved forward 1, 2, 3, or 4 spaces according to the number of yut sticks without any markings on the top, and they are called do, dog, girl, or yut.

If there are marks on all four yut sticks, it becomes 'mo' and advances 5 spaces.

If 'yut' or 'mo' comes out, throw the yut stick one more time and make an additional move.

If only one of the four yut sticks comes up with a special marked 'Do', it becomes 'Dui Do' and retreats 1 space.

If there is another player's piece where you land, you capture that piece, and the captured piece is expelled off the board and you have to start again.

However, if you catch another player's game pieces with 'Yut' or 'Mo', you will not be given another chance to throw.

In this way, the first player to score all game pieces is the winner!! no see.

Backgammon is one of the world’s most popular board games, brought to you by the makers of Nonogram.com and Sudoku.com puzzles. Install Backgammon for free now, train your brain and have fun with backgammon offline!

Backgammon board game (also known as Nardi or Tawla) is one of the oldest logic games in existence, alongside Chess and Go. People from all over the world have been playing backgammon classic for more than 5000 years to socialize with family and friends and keep their brains active. Now the game is available right on your device, and it's possible to enjoy the captivating game experience and play free backgammon anytime, anywhere.

How to play the backgammon game

- Classic backgammon is a logic puzzle for two, played on a board of 24 triangles. These triangles are called points.

- Each player sits on the opposite sides of the board with 15 checkers, black or white.

- To start the game, players take turns and roll the dice. That’s why free backgammon is often called a dice game.

- Players move pieces based on the numbers rolled. For example, if you roll 2 and 5, you can move one piece 2 points and another one 5 points. Alternatively, you can move one piece 7 points.

- Once all of a player’s pieces are in his or her “home”, that player may begin removing pieces off of the backgammon board.

- A player wins once all of their pieces are removed from the board

A few more things to know about this free Backgammon game

- Rolling two of the same number allows you to move 4 times. For example, for a roll of 4 and 4, you can move a total of 16 points, although each piece must move 4 points at a time.

- You cannot move a piece to a point that is occupied by 2 or more of your opponent’s pieces while playing a backgammon game.

- If you move a piece to a point with only 1 of your opponent’s pieces on it, the rival’s piece is removed from the board and placed on the middle partition.

Backgammon Free Features

- Enjoy a fair dice roll, which only the best backgammon games can boast.

- Undo a move if you made it accidentally or came up with a better one right after

- Your possible moves are highlighted to help you make an easier decision

- A simple and intuitive design to better focus on the game

- Start with easy opponents and face more difficult ones as you practice on your way to becoming the backgammon king.

Interesting facts about backgammon

- Ancient Romans, Greeks, and Egyptians all loved playing backgammon (known as tawla or narde).

- Backgammon is a classic game of luck and strategy. While any dice game is pretty much pure luck, there’s also an infinite number of strategies that even include predicting your opponent’s moves.

- One thing logic games have in common – they keep your brain sharp. It may not be difficult to learn the basics and practice playing backgammon with friends offline or online, but you’ll need an entire lifetime to become a true lord of the board.

Backgammon classic is one of the most popular free board games ever. Download it now and challenge yourself with backgammon offline!

description:
******* Ludo *******

Ludo App offline Game - No wifi Games

Ludo is a strategy board game for 2 to 4 players can play, without partnerships, in which the players race their four tokens from start to finish according to the rolls of a single die. The objective of the game is to navigate one's pieces across the board using die rolls, with the first player to get all four pieces to the center "home" space winning the game. Ludo is known for its simple rules and engaging gameplay, making it popular among children and families.

******* Checkers *******

Checkers, also known as draughts, is a strategy board game for two players. It involves diagonal moves of uniform game pieces and mandatory captures by jumping over the opponent's pieces. The objective is to eliminate all the opponent's pieces from the board. Checkers is played on an 8×8 board with each player starting with 12 pieces placed on the dark squares of the first three rows closest to them.

******* Nine Men's Morris *******

Nine Men's Morris is an abstract strategy board game that is played on a board with three concentric squares connected by lines at the midpoints of their sides and at the center, creating 24 intersection points where pieces can be placed. Each player has nine pieces, or 'men', and the goal is to form 'mills'—alignments of three pieces in a row, allowing the removal of an opponent's piece. The game proceeds in three phases: placing pieces onto the board, moving pieces to adjacent points, and moving pieces to any vacant point. A player wins by reducing the opponent to two pieces, making it impossible to form mills, or by blocking all possible moves. Nine Men's Morris is known for its deep strategy, despite its simple rules.

Download and play strategy board game combo (Ludo, Checkers, Nine Men's Morris, block puzzle , Tic Tac Toe , Block Crush , Block Game 2048) in one game!

description:
Northern line, crossed with "Zone 1". One cell, two criteria, one name to find. Angel works. Morden doesn't.

That's Doku. A 3×3 grid, nine cells, and at every intersection an answer that has to satisfy the row AND the column. Same idea as sudoku, except you fill it with metro stations, countries or heroes instead of digits. A daily trivia quiz that plays like a puzzle.

▶ FIVE UNIVERSES

Metrodoku: the Paris métro, the London Tube, the New York subway. Lines, terminus stations, boroughs, interchanges, stations sitting across two zones.

Geodoku: countries and capitals, and now the 101 French departments and the 50 US states. Flags, currencies, languages, state capitals, coastlines, rivers, time zones.

Loldoku: League of Legends champions. Classes, regions, species, resource, attack range, release year.

Pokédoku: all 1025 species. Types, generations, evolutions, legendaries, colours.

Dotadoku: Dota 2 heroes. Attributes, roles, complexity, Arcanas, heroes from the Netflix series. Search understands nicknames, so "cm" and "antimage" are enough.

And you choose which ones appear on your home screen. Hide the universes you don't care about, without losing any of your scores.

▶ THE DAILY GRID

One new grid a day per universe, the same one for every player, with its difficulty announced before you start. Easy, medium or hard: you know what you are walking into.

▶ THE ORIGINALITY SCORE

Everyone answers King's Cross. Answer something else. The rarer your answer among today's players, the more it scores. That is where the leaderboard is won, not on speed: a grid filled in thirty seconds with the nine obvious answers is worth very little.

▶ STREAKS AND LEADERBOARD

Miss a day and the streak goes back to zero. Every universe keeps its own. The leaderboard gathers the whole community.

▶ WITH FRIENDS

Add friends and compare today's grid cell by cell. You find out fairly quickly who was bluffing about knowing the metro.

▶ FREE PLAY

As many grids as you want, easy to expert, in every universe, offline included. Handy on the underground, as it happens.

▶ WHEN AN ANSWER IS REFUSED

The game doesn't just say no. It shows which criterion isn't met, restates the rule, and displays the real value for your answer. You learn something from every miss.

▶ DOKU+

Zero ads, scoring for your free games, every possible answer and your stats vs. everyone, every past grid, unlimited riddles and a streak protected for two days.

No account needed to play: open the app, start a grid. The daily trivia sudoku, quiz included, in English and in French.

FULLY FUNCTIONAL SCOREBOARD (101)

PENALTY POINTS ARE NOT TO BE SKIPPED

Throwing an Okey tile, playing a playable tile, and having your Okey tile removed from the table will instantly result in a penalty. The game will tell you why you received the penalty at that moment.

SHOP AND APPEARANCE

Tables, racks, frames, and stickers are opened with in-game chips. It's all just for show; it has no effect on the game. Vibration when dragging the stone, sound when throwing.

Backgammon Features

Classic backgammon rules

Backgammon follows the familiar two player board format with dice rolls, checker movement, and tactical decisions. You move pieces around the board while trying to bear them off before the opponent does. Because the game keeps the core rules at the center, it can suit players who already know Backgammon as Tawla, Tavla, Tavli, Nardi, or Shesh Besh.

Live online matches

Backgammon lets you play against real players from different regions through online multiplayer. The focus is not only on taking turns, but also on reacting to live choices from another player. As a result, each match can feel different because dice rolls, board position, and opponent strategy all affect the next move.

Friends, login, and chat

You can connect through Facebook or Google to save progress and play with friends. During matches, chat features support simple social interaction while the game continues. Tournaments and progression rewards

Backgammon includes daily tournaments, challenges, dice quests, leaderboards, trophies, rings, coins, and prizes. These systems give returning players clear goals after regular matches. Bonus modes and collectibles

How to play

Each player has 6 pits and a store. Pick up all stones from one of your pits and sow them one by one counter-clockwise. If your last stone lands in your store, you play again; if it makes the stones in an opponent's pit even, you capture them all. The game ends when one side runs out of stones – the player with the most stones in their store wins.

description:
My son started learning Go at seven. One lesson a week at the dojo, and he wanted

to keep practising at home - but I could not find an app I was comfortable handing

him. Sign-in walls, ads, recurring subscriptions. So I wrote this one.

Learning Go for the first time? Start here: follow a clear path from placing stones, liberties and captures to capture-1,

capture-3 and capture-5 challenges, then a guided introduction to territory on 9x9.

Learn the rules by playing and move naturally into a complete game. This beginner course is free.

10,000+ PROBLEMS

Organised by theme - liberties, atari and capture, connect and cut, shape, snapback,

shortage of liberties, net, squeeze, semeai, life and death. The collection includes

420 explained beginner rule exercises across ten units. Layered hints and explanations

help you understand why a move works, not just where to play.

9x9, 13x13 AND 19x19

Use 9x9 to learn captures and territory or finish a shorter game, 13x13 for fighting

and middlegame practice, and 19x19 for the full Go experience. Chinese rules,

adjustable komi, undo, pass, resign and move hints are always within reach.

KATAGO, RUNNING ON YOUR PHONE

Go AI runs KataGo, a state-of-the-art neural network Go engine, natively on your

device - not on a server. Play on a plane, on the subway, anywhere you have a few

minutes.

22 LEVELS, 18 KYU TO AMATEUR 4 DAN

Weaker levels don't just play slightly worse - they make the kind of mistakes a real

player at that rank makes, so every game stays honest and instructive. KataGo's

Human SL model is included too, in three styles: modern, traditional and varied.

REVIEW EVERY GAME

Step through any finished game move by move with a win-rate graph, see exactly where

the game turned, and check the top candidate moves at any point.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

23 growth milestones mark the journey from your first stone and first capture to wins

against every AI rank. Celebrations make each achievement visible. Win rate, streaks

and complete game history are stored separately for each local player.

PRIVACY

No account, no ads, no third-party analytics SDK. Your games and records stay on your

phone and are not uploaded. The app may fetch a small configuration file at launch;

AI play, training and review continue to work offline after installation. Purchases

and configuration updates require a connection.

Whether you are starting from the rules themselves, grinding tsumego to climb from

12 kyu toward amateur dan, or you just want a strong offline opponent in your pocket

- Go AI is built for you.

Try AI games, training and hints for free.

A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited games, training and hints. No subscription.

Crazzy Ludo is the smart crazy ludo game where strategy and skill beat luck. Play with friends, family, or AI in classic 2 player, 3 player, and 4 player matches, online or offline. Save your dice, plan smart moves, and become the king of the board.

WHY PLAY CRAZZY LUDO?

Most dice board games come down to lucky rolls. Crazzy Ludo changes that with a unique Dice Saving system. Save your sixes, plan smart captures, and outplay opponents with real skill. This is smart strategy for players who want a true skill board game and a crazy ludo experience.

SAVE DICE, THE STRATEGY EDGE

The save dice mechanic makes Crazzy Ludo unlike any other game. Store great rolls in your dice bank and use them at the perfect moment.

- Save high dice rolls for surprise captures or safe home runs

- Turn weak rolls into winning moves with smart planning

- Combine saved dice for multi-token combos

- Play with or without Dice Saving. Your choice.

This twist turns classic play into a real strategy board game. The ludo strategy and dice strategy fans have been waiting for.

GAME MODES

- Online Multiplayer: Play ludo online with friends

- Local Multiplayer: 2 player, 3 player, and 4 player on one device

- Pass and Play: Take turns with friends and family on a single phone

- Offline AI Mode: Beat smart computer opponents anytime, no internet, no signup

- 2v2 Team Mode: Partner up for coordinated team battles

- Classic Mode: Pure traditional rules for purists

SMART AI THAT CHALLENGES YOU

Three difficulty levels that play like real opponents:

- Beginner: Great for kids learning the game

- Expert: A balanced multiplayer challenge

- Master: Aggressive AI that uses save dice against you

CUSTOM CAPTURE AND FINISH SOUNDS

Crazzy Ludo brings a crazy ludo twist to classic play: upload your own audio for the biggest moments. Set a custom sound for token captures. Set another for finishing a token at home. Use the preset library or pick any audio file from your phone. Celebrate every capture with your favorite movie line, song clip, or victory shout.

ONLINE AND OFFLINE

Play offline ludo anywhere with no internet, no signup, and no data charges. Play online ludo with friends when you are connected. Works on flights, long drives, subway commutes, weekend trips, or quiet evenings at home. Same save dice rules online or offline.

LUDO BY ANY NAME

The classic dice board game goes by many names, and Crazzy Ludo is all of them. In South Asia it is known as ludo, ludo wala game, ludo chakka, chakka, crazy ludo, ludo goti, or bina net wala ludo. In Spain and Latin America it is parchís, parchisi, parcheesi, or pachisi. In ancient tradition it is chaupar or chopat. Around the world players also call it lido, lodo, ludu, leedo, and laadhuu. One classic board game, a hundred names.

PERFECT FOR

- Families wanting an offline ludo game or online ludo

- Friends gathering for local multiplayer board game fun

- Kids learning strategy, patience, and math

- Ludo and parchisi fans tired of luck-based games

- Travelers and commuters needing a great offline board game

FREQUENTLY ASKED

- Need internet? No for offline play. Yes for online multiplayer.

- Need an account? No signup required.

- Can I play 2 player ludo on one phone? Yes. 3 player and 4 player too, with pass and play.

- Can I upload my own sound for captures? Yes. Use the preset library or any audio file.

- What makes Crazzy Ludo unique? Save dice strategy and custom capture and finish sounds in this crazy ludo board game.

- Can I play online with friends? Yes. Online multiplayer is available now.

COMING SOON

- Global leaderboards and ranked tournaments

- More board themes and customization

PLAY CRAZZY LUDO

The crazy ludo board game where skill beats luck. No signup. Play online or offline. Roll the dice, save your sixes, and become the king of the board.

FOLLOW US

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/crazzyludo

YouTube: https://youtube.com/@crazzyludogame

Questions or feedback? Email support@crazzyludo.com.

description:
One vault. Everything inside is a different size, and all of it is sealed. Four bidders at the same table. Five sealed rounds. Only the winner takes anything home - the other three leave with nothing.

The hard part is not the money. The hard part is that you cannot see what you are bidding on.

EVERY ROUND SHOWS A LITTLE MORE

Crates sit on an 8x6 board in footprints from 1x1 to 3x3. At the start you cannot even see their shapes. Each round opens something - sometimes a grade, sometimes a category, sometimes only a size. Knowing the vault is full of Mythics tells you nothing if they are all 1x1.

WIN EARLY, PAY MORE

Beat the second-highest bid by the round's multiplier and the hammer falls immediately:

Round 1 - 2.0x

Round 2 - 1.5x

Round 3 - 1.3x

Round 4 - 1.1x

Round 5 - highest bid wins

Ending it gets cheaper every round. So does your information advantage.

OVERPAY AND THEY ALL EAT

Pay more than the vault is really worth and the surplus is split evenly between the three players you just beat. Losing to a reckless bidder is a payday. Winning at a stupid price buys everyone a round.

FOUR COMMANDERS, FOUR WAYS OF LOOKING

Bunda Susi - reads the grade of what nobody else is looking at.

Bejo Ganteng - barges in and measures the biggest thing in the vault.

Budi Perkasa - takes stock: the cheap shelves first, their sizes later.

Icha Aja - picks one crate and tells you exactly what it is.

No commander sees everything. What you know, your rivals may not - and the other way round.

THE GOODS ARE FROM THE MARKET DOWN THE ROAD

Machetes, saucepans, sarongs, flip-flops, meatball soup, satay, prawn crackers, iced tea, marbles, kites, carnival effigies, shadow puppets. Nine categories, ninety goods, every one hand-drawn in pixels.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Play online against real people, or against the computer any time

- Start playing without signing up - a guest account can take an email later

- Climb from Warrior to Immortal and watch the leaderboard

- Display figurines in a six-slot cabinet that earns coins every hour

- Browse an encyclopedia of every treasure, grade and footprint in the game

- Play in Indonesian or English, switchable in settings

Landscape. Pixel art. A round takes minutes.

Inspired by the Magic Auction mode from Magic Chess: Go Go. This is an independent game and is not affiliated with it.

Ludo is a classic dice and race game, played with four pieces per house and a set of dice.

FEATURES

More boards added: you can choose among three colourful boards.(use the more button from the first screen to access this feature).

**Speed control added. You can control how fast a Piece move.

**You can enable or disable barrier

**You can enable or disable safe-house

**You can position board the way you like

**You can choose to play with one die or two dice

**You can decide to remove a piece when it captures opponent's piece or not

**You can decided to play again when you capture opponent's piece irrespective of the outcome.

All these features are accessible through Options.

--------SUPPORTED LANGUAGES------

** English

** French

** Italian

** Indonesian

** German

** Spanish

** Portuguese

------------HOW TO PLAY--------------

Ludo is a classic dice and race game, played with four pieces per player and a set of dice. This Ludo currently support two players with two houses each. In this game, each player controls eight pieces. The goal of the game is to move all eight pieces home before your opponent.

------------MOVEMENT OF PIECE--------

A player with red house starts the game (in a case of winning, the loser starts the game with red house).

A piece can only come out of house when a die outcome is 6 but a piece that is already on the track can move with any dice outcome. Pieces travel through the track starting from home to the middle of the board. A track contains 56 steps.

A piece can only be removed if it successfully travels through the 56 steps or if it captures opponent's piece.

----------------PIECE CAPTURE-------------------

A player's piece can capture opponent's piece if it ends in a block that is occupied by an opponent's. The captured piece must be returned home while the player's piece is removed from the board.

The secret of the game is to capture your opponent's piece as many as possible and avoid being captured by your opponent's piece.

A piece cannot capture opponent's piece if the remaining outcome cannot be used.

----------IMPORTANT NOTE-----------

1. A player can only roll dice twice consecutively or more as far as each dice outcome is 6 (first dice outcome = 6 and second dice outcome = 6).

2. Dice outcome must be played before rolling another one no matter the outcome.

3. For fast and smooth play, go to settings and turn on DIRECT COUNT.

description:
Alkkagi 3D is the Korean stone-flicking board game, rebuilt in 3D with real physics.

Flick a Go stone with your finger and knock every rival stone off the board. If you enjoy carrom, crokinole or marble shooter games, Alkkagi will feel familiar right away — but it is played on a Go board, and one well-aimed shot can clear three stones at once.

Free to play. Works offline. No account needed.

▶ FOUR GAME MODES

1. Baduk Mode — classic Alkkagi with black and white Go stones. Place your stones anywhere you like before the match starts.

2. Janggi Mode — flick Janggi pieces (Korean chess). Each piece has a different weight, so a General pushes harder than a Soldier.

3. Line Mode — stop your stone as close to the target line as you can without falling off. Up to 7 players take turns on one phone.

4. Stage Mode — 50 single-player missions. From stage 21 the white stones move and dodge, so you have to lead your shot.

▶ 2 PLAYER ON ONE PHONE

Pass and play with a friend on a single device. No internet, no second phone, no sign-up. Alkkagi 3D is a two player board game built for sitting across a table — at home, on a trip, or during a holiday get-together.

▶ BEAT ALKKAGO, THE AI

Alkkago is the built-in AI opponent with 50 ranks, from Beginner to Master. Win and the next rank unlocks; drop back to any rank you have already cleared whenever you want an easier match. The AI aims better and its stones grow heavier as you climb.

▶ COLLECT 20 SPECIAL STONES

Copper, Jade, Silver, Gold, Diamond and 15 more — from Red Copper to Galaxy. Buy them with points in the shop, or unlock them by clearing achievements such as winning matches, climbing AI ranks, finishing stages or checking in daily.

Each tier carries its own ability:

· Copper — longer aim guide

· Jade — brake, so your stone stops after impact instead of sliding off

· Silver — heavy, so enemy hits push you less

· Gold — piercing shot that keeps going after the first hit

· Diamond — survive one fall off the board

You may field only one stone of each kind per match, so the more of the collection you unlock, the more ways you can build your line-up.

▶ MADE TO FEEL RIGHT

· Two shot styles — push shot or pull shot, like a slingshot. Pick the one your thumb prefers.

· Drag farther and faster for a stronger shot.

· Pinch and drag to move the 3D camera around the board.

· 7-day check-in calendar with a free Copper Stone on day 2.

· Settings for language (English / Korean), sound effects, music, vibration and notifications.

▶ WHO IT IS FOR

· Anyone looking for a 2 player board game to play offline with a friend

· Fans of carrom, crokinole, air hockey and other flicking or shooting games

· Players who grew up flicking Go stones and miss the feel of it

· Anyone who wants a single-player puzzle board game with 50 stages

▶ ABOUT ALKKAGI

Alkkagi (알까기) is a traditional Korean game played on a baduk board, the same board used for Go. Two players set out the same number of stones, then take turns flicking them to push the other side off the edge. The last player with stones left wins. It is simple to learn in one round and still fun after a hundred.

Alkkagi 3D brings that game to your phone with 3D stones, real collision physics and a camera you can swing around the board.

▶ FAQ

Do I need an internet connection?

No. Every mode, including 2 player and all 50 stages, works offline.

Is there online multiplayer?

Not yet. Two player is local only — you share one device and take turns.

Is it free?

Yes. The game is free with ads, and an optional Remove Ads pack is available. Special stones can always be earned with points from playing.

What language is the game in?

English and Korean.

Have fun :D

description:
A PROMISE TO MY GRANDFATHER.

Every Sunday he taught me chess at the kitchen table. He said that one day someone in this family would be world champion. He passed before it happened. The board stayed.

Rival Chess is that promise turned into a game. Eight championships, 56 rivals, one title at the end — and a goddess waiting behind the last door.

FROM THE STREET TO THE INTERPLANETARY.

You start out playing in the square and finish across the board from Caïssa. Every rival is calibrated to your level. Every boss you beat unlocks the next title. Nobody gets a medal for showing up here: you become champion, or you go back and try again.

ARCADE CHESS, NOT A SIMULATOR.

Pick your fight. Take down the boss. Climb to the next championship. From Tito in the Square to Caïssa the Eternal, every opponent has a name, a face, a way of talking and a real rating — all hand-written, one by one.

A win pushes you up. A loss becomes training, and I mean that literally: see below.

A 1200 RIVAL BLUNDERS THE WAY A 1200 BLUNDERS.

This is the hard part, and it is where almost every chess app falls short. A traditional engine fakes weakness by cutting its search depth: it finds a beautiful tactic and then hangs its queen three moves later. Nobody plays like that.

Here the opponents run on our own neural network, conditioned on rating, covering 600 to 2699, trained on millions of real human games. It does not play badly on purpose — it goes wrong in the places a person at that level would go wrong.

Thinking time is not random either. It comes from a model trained on 5.6 million real Lichess moves, watching the position, the phase of the game, the clock, whether a threat is in the air, whether it is a recapture. Your rival does not answer on a metronome beat. It stalls exactly where a person would stall.

YOUR OWN MISTAKES BECOME DRILLS.

No generic puzzles pulled from a database. The app finds the exact instant YOUR game turned — the move where the win slipped away — and hands that position back to you. Same board, same pressure, opponent at the same level. Blundered at 1850? You go back in against an 1850. Now hold it.

INSIGHTS

Discover your next focus. Train with positions from your own games. Understand your results in plain language, revisit your mistakes and follow your progress. Insights and practice are free; Lifetime opens the full journey.

EVERYTHING RUNS ON YOUR DEVICE.

No server in the middle, no games of yours wandering around out there, no monthly bill.

THE 8 CHAMPIONSHIPS

1. The Street — free and unlimited, no card required

2. The Neighborhood

3. The City

4. The State

5. The National

6. The Continental

7. The World

8. The Interplanetary — the final boss, against Caïssa herself

COACHES WHO NOTICE WHAT YOU GET WRONG

Three masters guide your drills: The Library Sage, Master Helena and the Sensei. Each one teaches the pattern YOU keep missing, not the generic lesson that suits everybody. The Library Sage is free from day one; Helena and the Sensei come with Lifetime.

HOW IT WORKS

• You play rivals at your level

• The app finds your worst moves on its own

• Each one becomes a Survival Drill

• You go back into the position and have to hold it to the end

WHAT COMES WITH IT

• Unlimited games against opponents at your level

• 56 rivals spread across 8 championships

• Survival Drills pulled from your own games

• Full analysis of every game

• Separate Bullet, Blitz and Rapid ratings

• Title progression, from Street Champion upward

• 3 masters to unlock

• Boards and pieces to customize

• History with replay of everything you have played

NO SUBSCRIPTION.

Pay once and that is it. No monthly fee, no lives to recharge, no catch.

For the promise. For the family. Start now.

description:
TileBuddy is the mahjong scoring app for real-table play. Hong Kong and Taiwan. Track every win, scan tiles with AI, and look up hand values in seconds. Whether you're settling scores at the table or still learning, TileBuddy handles the math.

HONG KONG & TAIWAN

Play Hong Kong (13-tile, faan) or Taiwanese (16-tile, base and tai). Pick your ruleset and the whole app follows: the win screen, the scoring, and the wiki. Taiwanese settles as base plus total tai times the tai value, with the dealer streak applied per settlement the way it's actually played.

REFEREE MODE

Track scores during your game without doing the math. Enter player names, set your stakes and scoring table, and TileBuddy handles every payment calculation. Self-pick wins, discard wins, configurable payment styles (standard or "discarder pays all"). Wind rotation and dealer tracking happen automatically. Undo any round with one tap.

WINS-ONLY MODE

Don't want to track points? Switch to wins-only mode and just count who won each round. Per-player W counters on every seat. Discard wins skip the scoring step entirely. Built for casual nights where you only care about the W.

AI HAND SCANNER

Point your camera at your winning hand and let AI identify the tiles. The Hand Scanner recognizes all 42 tile types: Bamboo, Dots, Characters, Winds, Dragons, Flowers, and Seasons. It works out your faan or tai from the tiles it reads, and you can correct anything it gets wrong before you log the hand.

BUILD THE HAND YOUR WAY

Tap tiles into a flat pool, or build the hand meld by meld with a concealed switch on each one. Meld-by-meld entry lets the app score concealment and kongs exactly, and it's remembered separately for each ruleset.

Tawletna is classic backgammon with modern fairness: every online roll is provably fair. The server commits to the dice before the match starts, and after the match you can verify each roll you saw — in the app or in any browser. No feel, no trust-me. Proof.

THREE GAMES, THREE LADDERS

• Backgammon — the game you know, doubling cube and all

• Plakoto (Mahbusa) — nothing is ever hit. Land on a lone checker and you pin it where it stands; trap the mother on the starting point and you win double, instantly

• Fevga (Moultezim) — both sides run the same way round the board and never meet head-on. One checker owns a point, so you build walls instead of hitting

Each game has its own ranked ELO ladder and its own trained AI. One wallet across all three, and six daily missions — two for each game.

RANKED ONLINE PLAY

• Real opponents, server-checked moves, ELO rating and tier ladder

• The Crown Road: a lifetime reward track that grows with your ranked wins

• Ranked seasons — the first one is coming soon

• Friends, private matches with a room code, and a global leaderboard

NINE RIVALS WITH REAL PERSONALITIES

Play against nine hand-crafted rivals across three difficulty tiers — from friendly beginners to a neural-network Grandmaster. Each rival has its own temperament: the aggressive ones hunt your blots, the careful ones lock their board. Same rules, different characters.

LEARN THE GAME PROPERLY

• An illustrated guide with six lessons for each game, most of them played on the board itself — moving, hitting, pinning, building walls, the doubling cube, bearing off

• A live coach that flags blunders before you commit them, vs the AI and in pass-and-play (Tawletna+)

• Full match analysis that shows you the move you missed (Tawletna+)

Tawletna+ is an optional paid membership.

PLAY ANYWHERE

• Offline vs the AI — no internet needed

• Pass-and-play with a friend on one device

• Phones and tablets, light and dark themes, a shelf of board styles

MAKE IT YOURS

Boards, dice, profile rings, avatars and titles — earned through play or bought with coins in the store. Trophies, honor cups and a hall to show them off.

FAIR MEANS FAIR

No gambling, no stakes, no coin losses — rewards come from playing well. Online dice are cryptographically committed before each match and verifiable after it.

Backgammon is played around the world as Tavla, Tawla, Nardi and Shesh Besh, and its cousins as Mahbusa, Plakoto, Moultezim and Fevga — however you learned it, the board is waiting.

Chinese chess with a twist: every piece starts face-down, and when you flip it, it might switch to your opponent's side! A 2 player strategy board game you can play offline vs AI or online with friends. Learn in 1 minute.

Co Up (dark chess, also called Jieqi, flip chess or hidden chess) is a fun chess variant built on Xiangqi. It keeps the moves of classic Chinese chess but adds hidden pieces, surprise and a little luck. No two games are the same.

♟️ WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

• All pieces start hidden. Only the two Generals are face-up, so nobody knows which piece is which, not even their own.

• A hidden piece moves like the piece whose starting square it stands on. After it moves, it flips over and shows what it really is.

• The twist: a flipped piece may belong to your opponent and instantly joins their side. Every flip is a gamble.

• Hidden pieces can be captured by anything. Revealed pieces capture by normal Xiangqi rules.

• Advisors and Elephants are free: Advisors roam diagonally across the whole board, and Elephants may cross the river.

🎮 GAME MODES

• Play vs the computer with 3 AI levels (Easy, Medium, Hard). Works offline, no internet needed, so it is also one of those 2 player games offline you can take anywhere.

• Local 2 player mode on one phone or tablet.

• Real-time online matchmaking: play Chinese chess online or Xiangqi online, there is always someone to play.

• Add friends and invite them to a match.

🎯 HOW TO WIN

Checkmate or capture the opponent's General. Lose your General and the game is over.

📖 THE PIECES (16 per side)

• General: 1 step up, down, left or right.

• Advisor: moves diagonally.

• Elephant: 2 steps diagonally.

• Horse: an L-shape move, can be blocked.

• Chariot: any distance in a straight line.

• Cannon: moves like the Chariot, captures by jumping over exactly 1 piece.

• Soldier: 1 step forward, and also sideways after crossing the river.

New to Chinese chess? The built-in tutorial (video and pictures) shows Chinese chess how to play step by step, so you can learn Chinese chess while you play.

⭐ FEATURES

• Seasonal ELO ranking with 8 tiers: Pawn, Advisor, Elephant, Horse, Cannon, Chariot, General, Chess King.

• Replay every game move by move.

• 5 piece styles: Jade & Ivory, Cast Bronze, Minimal, Flat Neo, Lacquer.

• Sound effects and music for flips, captures and check.

• Clean dark design that fits every screen.

WHY PLAY?

Love board games for 2 players, fun chess, chess variants, fog of war chess or games to play with friends? This Chinese chess game mixes real strategy with surprise, a 2 player strategy board game that also works as a quick party board game. Xiangqi fans get a fresh challenge, and beginners can win thanks to a lucky flip.

Snakes and Ladders, exactly as you remember it. Roll the die, climb the ladders, dodge the snakes, race to 100. No ads, no sign-in, no internet permission at all — the whole game lives on your phone.

Play solo against your own record, pass the phone around for up to four players, or fill the empty seats with CPU opponents when nobody else is nearby.

WAYS TO PLAY

• Solo — one player, one board, chasing your fastest finish.

• Local — 2 to 4 players sharing a single device, hot-seat style.

• Vs CPU — every opponent seat played by the computer, so a game is always ready.

THREE BOARDS

• Easy — gentler snakes, and you do not need an exact roll to finish. A good first board.

• Classic — the traditional layout, exact finish required.

• Hard — longer snakes, more of them, exact finish required. Square 99 is not your friend.

THE RULES YOU GREW UP WITH

Roll a 6 and you go again. Roll three 6s in a row and that turn is forfeited. Land on the foot of a ladder and climb it; land on a snake's head and slide all the way down. On Classic and Hard you need the exact number to land on 100, so the last few squares are their own little drama.

RECORDS AND STARS

Every finish is scored on your own roll count, not the table's, and each board keeps a separate record for every configuration — a fast solo Easy run will never shadow your Hard record. Finish at or under par for three stars, a little over for two. Your best rolls and best star rating are saved for each setup.

SIX THEMES

Meadow, Ocean, Sunset, Midnight, Aurora and Mono. Three of them are true dark themes for late-night play, and Mono is pure black, easy on OLED screens. The chosen theme colours the entire app, status bar included, and the picker previews each one rather than listing names.

BUILT TO FEEL GOOD

The die tumbles before it settles, tokens walk square by square then take the ladder or the snake, and a win throws confetti in the winner's colour. Subtle haptics on every tap, plus optional tones that are off by default. Everything is drawn on a single canvas, so it stays smooth on older phones and the download stays tiny.

NEVER LOSE A GAME

Leave mid-race — a call, a notification, a closed app — and every token position, whose turn it is, and the roll count all come back exactly as you left them. Continue is waiting on the home screen.

STATS

Games started, games won, and your best finish and star rating on each of the three boards, all in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No internet permission. No ads. No accounts. No analytics. No in-app purchases. Nothing to collect, because nothing ever leaves your device. Works fully offline — on a plane, in the underground, anywhere.

A board game for the family that does not need a board, a die, or a single one of those small plastic tokens that always ends up under the sofa.

description:
Fidchell, which is also called Faery Chess or Celtic Chess, is an ancient celtic game which was mentioned in multiple Irish epics and chronicles. Under the name of Gwyddbwyll it also appears in the Welsh Mabinogion and seems to have been held in peculiar reverence throughout the British Isles. Faery Chess is what emerged from Nigel Suckling's investigations and speculations about the lost game.

The game is played an a board consisting of circles and lines on which the game pieces are placed and can move along. Similar to games like the ancient abstract board game Nine Men's Morris the pieces are first placed onto the board in turn and moved afterwards once all of them have been placed. The capturing of pieces works differently though and is alike to Tafl games: a piece gets captured if a player traps it between two of his own pieces. This even grants him another move with which he may trap another one and so on.

The app features two variants of the game: the basic edition which is easier to understand and where both players are treated equally and the advanced version which has different goals for both players. The general goal is to connect the central Naval stone with the border of the board by forming a connected line of stones.

This app features both game modes for offline play against a human or the computer/AI and asynchronous online play against humans.

The app is ad supported. These ads can be permanently deactivated through an one-time In App Purchase (IAP).
