Ultimate Game Buzzer turns every phone or tablet at the table into a buzzer, a timer, and a game show host. No internet, no account, no typing. It works in airplane mode, in the cabin, at the campsite, and in the basement where the Wi-Fi does not reach.

PLAY TOGETHER

Every phone or tablet at the table is a buzzer. They find each other over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, no internet needed. First press wins, and the host is the judge. Free for tables up to 4 players. Teams share a screen, so a table of 4 can seat a room. Point a phone at the table's code to join, even before you have installed it.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY, ONE TAP EACH

BUZZER. One giant button. Press it. Seven sound levels, from library-quiet to a level we had to put a warning on. Two players can share one phone.

TIMER. A countdown you can see from across the room, with a pulse in the last ten seconds and a flash in the last three. Built for any turn-based board game.

DON'T SAY IT. The word-guessing game timer: hourglass countdown, a buzz for every forbidden word, and start and reset that never get in the way.

CATEGORIES. The categories game, rebuilt. Roll a letter, get your categories, race the clock. Difficulty levels up to Doctorate, thirteen themes, 780 original categories. Share a code and another phone or tablet gets the same list, no network required.

QUIZ SHOW. Ten questions a round, everyone answers on their own screen, and the fastest right answer scores most. The animal pack shows a real photograph for every creature. Play alone against three friendly rivals, or put the board on a TV with screen mirroring and the host's phone becomes the remote.

TOP ANSWERS. Two teams guess the most popular answers on the board. Packs written by our team plus boards built from real public records. In Ask the Table, the room types its own answers and those become the board.

MAKE YOUR OWN

Build your own category lists, quiz packs, and Top Answers boards, then play them at your table like any other pack.

SOLO TOO

Every mode has a play-on-this-screen option for practice, small tables, or a car ride.

BUILT FOR THE TABLE

Big buttons anyone can use without instructions. Dark screen for dim rooms. Haptics on every buzz. Sound levels that respect your neighbours or wake them, your choice.

FREE, WITH ADS

Every mode is free. Tables up to 4 players are free. Categories levels up to High School are free, and so is your first custom list. A fresh pack arrives every week, and one Pro pack is free each week. Ads appear between rounds, never during one, and never on the player phones.

BUZZER PRO, ONE PURCHASE

Pay once, keep it forever. No subscription.

• No ads

• Tables up to 8 players

• College and Doctorate category lists

• Unlimited custom category lists, quiz packs, and Top Answers boards

Restore purchases on any device.

SEASONAL PACKS

Thanksgiving Table and Holiday Night, each bought once and kept. Each adds a 49-question quiz pack plus boards or lists for the other modes. These are separate from Buzzer Pro and are not included with it.

LANGUAGES

English, Spanish, French, German. Mode names use what each language already calls the game.

MONOPOLY GO! fits players who want short rounds during a break or a commute. It adapts the classic property trading loop for tap controls and clear prompts, while rotating themes keep each session fresh, including limited collaborations set in Springfield. You can play solo or invite friends for quick turns, and steady progression comes from regular events and official codes. Because the flow is streamlined, it supports daily check ins without long matches. To get started, download MONOPOLY GO! and choose how you want to play.


MONOPOLY GO! features

Mobile Monopoly built for quick turns

MONOPOLY GO! delivers the familiar roll, buy and build loop with simple taps. You move across the board, collect Properties, and place Houses and Hotels with clear on screen choices. Classic Tokens return, and the presentation is tailored for phones so turns finish quickly. The game is created by Scopely and based on the Hasbro board game.

Play solo or with friends

You can jump into solo sessions or connect with friends for social play. Linking Facebook or your contacts unlocks Community Chest cooperative moments, playful Bank Heists, and in game chat for coordination. If you prefer a quiet round, you can skip linking and continue at your own pace. Progress syncs as you return, so short sessions remain productive.

Themed boards and collaborations

Boards cycle through world cities, fantasy locations, and special collaborations. Current highlights include a Simpsons theme across Springfield with Mr. Monopoly guiding the tour. New themes arrive on a schedule, which keeps the map visuals and event goals varied. As themes change, expect different art styles, tokens, and timed objectives.

Events, tournaments and mini games

Frequent events run on hourly and daily cycles, which makes it easy to slot play into small windows. Tournaments offer structured competition, while mini games like Prize Drop and Cash Grab provide quick chances at extra dice and cash. Clear timers and prompts show when to jump in. This cadence supports steady progress without long sessions.

Sticker albums, trading and codes

Collect Stickers to fill themed albums and claim milestone rewards. Trading with friends helps complete sets faster, and community groups often organize swaps for hard to find cards. You can also redeem official reward codes to receive perks that support progression. The game is free to play with optional in app purchases, and all rewards remain in game with no real money payouts.


Before you download MONOPOLY GO!

  • The game uses rotating, limited time themes and collaborations. Content tied to a collaboration is available only while the event is active.

  • Official reward codes are provided by the developer. Enter codes in game to claim perks, and check back regularly for new releases.

  • Some social features rely on a Facebook or contacts connection. Linking is optional, but it enables Community Chest and easier trading.

  • An internet connection is required for multiplayer, events, trading, and code redemption. Offline play is limited.

  • MONOPOLY GO! is free to play with optional purchases. The app does not pay real money under any mode.


How to play MONOPOLY GO! on Android

Use these steps to start a round and keep progress moving in the MONOPOLY GO! latest version. The flow suits short sessions, so you can pause and return as events refresh.

  1. Open MONOPOLY GO! after installation. Follow the prompts to set your language, accept terms, and choose a guest session or a sign in option.

  2. If you want social play, link Facebook or allow contacts access when prompted. Otherwise, skip this step and continue to the main lobby.

  3. Tap the dice button to roll on the current themed board. When you land on an unowned Property, confirm the purchase, then build Houses and Hotels when a color set is complete.

  4. Return to the lobby between turns to check events and tournaments. Join Prize Drop, Cash Grab, or a scheduled competition when you have time.

  5. Open the Sticker Album to track set progress and manage trades with friends. In the settings or rewards area, redeem official codes to claim perks.


Get started with MONOPOLY GO!

MONOPOLY GO! brings streamlined Monopoly gameplay, rotating themes, and social options that fit short breaks. To jump in quickly, install the MONOPOLY GO! APK and follow the in game prompts to roll, build, and join events.

Classic Yahtzee play on mobile

This mode gives players a structured path when they do not want to wait for multiplayer turns. Experience the thrill of Reversi (a.k.a. Othello)! Challenge yourself against the AI engine on an 8x8 grid by flipping computer's pieces to conquer the board! This app is completely free and ad-free.

Game features

♦ Powerful game engine.

♦ Hint feature: the application will suggest next move for you.

♦ Undo last moves by pressing the back button.

♦ Gain experience points (XP) by earning game achievements (sign in is required).

♦ Compare your score against other players on the leaderboards (sign in is required).

♦ Import/export game on local and remote storage.

♦ Game engine performs multiple moves in case you have no valid place to go, due to the well known rule "If one player can not make a valid move, play passes back to the other player".

Main settings

♦ Level of difficulty, between 1 (easy) and 7 (difficult)

♦ Select player mode: application AI as white/black player or human vs. human mode

♦ Show/hide last move, show/hide valid moves, show/hide game animations

♦ Show emoticon (active only during last part of a game)

♦ Change color of game board

♦ Optional voice output and/or sound effects

Game rules

Each player must place a new piece in a position that there exists at least one straight (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) line between the new piece and another piece of the same color, with one or more contiguous opposite pieces between them.

Black color starts first move. When player cannot move, the other player takes the turn. When neither players can move, the game ends. The winner is the player that owns more pieces.

Dear friends, consider that this app doesn't contain advertisements, in-app purchases, so this app will evolve depending on your positive ratings. Be positive, be nice :-)

IMPORTANT NOTE: To ensure fair competition, the application includes anti-cheating measures. For instance, a win will not be recorded on Google Play if the player changes the difficulty level mid-game, uses the undo function, loads an external transcript, or switches player mode during the match.

description:
Nine Men's Morris and 5 more classic board games in one lightweight app! Play online with friends, challenge the computer offline, or pass and play on one device.

★ 6 CLASSIC BOARD GAMES IN ONE APP

Nine Men's Morris (Mills): The classic abstract strategy game. Place your pieces, line up three to form a mill and capture your opponent's pieces. Play the classic 9 Men board or the 12 Men variant with diagonal lines.

Checkers: Jump, capture and crown your kings in classic Draughts. Captures are compulsory, just like the traditional game.

Reversi: Trap your opponent's discs between yours to flip them. The player with the most discs at the end wins!

Four in a Row: Drop your discs into the columns and connect four in any direction: across, down or diagonally.

Dots & Boxes: Join two dots to draw a line, close a box to score and take another turn.

Tic Tac Toe: Quick, fun rounds of noughts and crosses against a friend or the computer.

★ PLAY ONLINE

Quick Match: Play a random online opponent in any of the 6 games.

Private Rooms: Create a room, share the code on any messaging app, and play with friends anywhere.

Reconnect: Lost your connection? Your match syncs again as soon as you are back online.

★ OFFLINE & 2 PLAYERS

Vs Computer: 3 levels to master: Sunny (Easy), Nova (Medium) and Titan (Hard).

Pass & Play: 2-player matches on one phone or tablet with family and friends.

No Internet Needed: Every game can be played offline.

★ WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT

Undo & Hints: Take back a move in offline games, and follow highlighted moves and hints to learn every game.

Board Styles: Pick your board (Maple, Walnut or Teal) and pieces (Ivory & Ebony or Mint & Blue).

Stats: Your wins, losses and draws are saved for each game.

Rematch Series: Rematch the computer or a friend and keep score across games.

Lightweight: Small download that runs smoothly on most phones.

Your Way: Sound, music and vibration can be switched on or off anytime.

6 Languages: English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português and Bahasa Indonesia.

★ HOW TO PLAY NINE MEN'S MORRIS

Place: Take turns placing your pieces on empty points.

Move: Once all pieces are placed, slide them to a neighbouring point.

Fly: Down to 3 pieces? Jump to any empty point on the board!

Form a mill (3 pieces in a row) to remove one of your opponent's pieces. Leave your opponent with 2 pieces or no legal moves to win!

Nine Men's Morris is also known as Mills, the Mill Game, Merels, Mühle, Molino, Moulin and Trilha.

Download now and enjoy 6 timeless board games with friends, online or offline!

Take part in the adventurous Squirrel race! Try yourself in a thrilling ride game “Racing Numbers” with a cute furry friend. It’s not just any ordinary race simulator, it is a good starting point for your kids in learning NUMBERS!

LEARN BY PLAYING

description:
Five dice, three rolls a turn, and thirteen boxes to fill as best you can. This is classic yatzy the way it's played around a kitchen table: keep the dice that help, roll the rest, then score a box — or cross one out. Thirteen rounds, and the total settles it.

A COMPUTER THAT ACTUALLY PLAYS

Three levels, three different games:

• EASY keeps the most frequent dice and takes the points in front of it.

• NORMAL computes the expected value of the next roll for every one of the 32 ways to hold your dice.

• RUTHLESS reasons over both remaining rolls and the value of every open box, bonus included. In simulated head-to-head games it beats the Easy level 80 to 95% of the time — and it plays without making you wait.

SIX PLAYERS, ONE PHONE

Pass and play, 2 to 6 players: the phone goes around the table, everyone plays their turn, and the score sheet does the bookkeeping. Player names are fully editable, and an interrupted game picks up exactly where it stopped, even after the app is closed.

THE SCORE SHEET, DONE PROPERLY

• The thirteen classic boxes: Aces through Sixes, Three of a kind, Four of a kind, Full house, Small straight, Large straight, Yam's — five of a kind — and Chance.

• The 35-point bonus at 63 in the upper section, with a no-bonus variant for those who play it that way.

• While you play, every combination still open shows the points it would actually score: you choose with the numbers in front of you.

• Any box can be crossed out for zero, just like on paper. Subtotals, bonus and totals add themselves up.

One honest note on the rules: this is the classic 13-box sheet — Full house 25, Small straight 30, Large straight 40, bonus 35. If the yatzy you grew up with is the 15-box Scandinavian sheet, with One pair, Two pairs and a 50-point bonus, you won't find those boxes here.

UP AND RUNNING IN A MINUTE

• The app asks for your name once, on first launch: after that a solo game starts in a single tap.

• A "Rules and scoring" screen lists the thirteen combinations and what each one pays, readable mid-game.

• Scored the wrong box? "Undo" takes it back, as long as the dice haven't been rolled again.

YOUR NUMBERS, YOUR PROGRESS

Your personal best sits on the home screen, a new record gets celebrated at the end of the game, and a statistics screen tracks what matters: games played, best game, average score, Yams rolled.

BUILT FOR PLAYING IN PEACE

• A felt table, a paper score sheet, big readable dice: nothing flashes, nothing nags.

• Held dice lift off the felt, so one glance tells you what stays and what rolls.

• Dice animation can be turned off; light, dark or system theme.

SIMPLE AND HONEST

• Works entirely offline — no account, no sign-up.

• No ads, no videos between turns, nothing to watch before you can keep playing.

• Your scores stay on your phone and nowhere else.

• Solo play and the Normal computer are included. A single one-time purchase — one payment, no subscription — unlocks pass and play, the Easy and Ruthless levels and the statistics, for good. A restore button brings the purchase back on a new phone.

And the name? Yam's is what this game is called in France, where this app was made. The same five dice go by yatzy in Northern Europe and generala in South America — thirteen turns, one sheet, and the small cruelty of crossing out a box when nothing will roll your way.

Roll. Hold. Roll again. Where you put the rest is up to you.

Şeşbeş brings classic Turkish backgammon over without softening the rules. If you are hit, you enter from the bar first. If only one die is playable, you play the higher one. If the point is blocked, you pass. Nothing added, nothing removed.

ONLINE TABLES

You are matched with a real player who picked the same table. A Rookie table stakes 500 gold, a Legend table 250,000. Winner takes the pot, a gammon doubles it. If your opponent leaves the table, the stake stays with you.

THE PHILOSOPHERS

Descartes, Nietzsche, Socrates, Plato, Confucius and Bacon sit across from you. Each one tougher than the last, each with a line adapted for the board. "Stare long into the dice, and the dice stare back at you."

WITH FRIENDS

Take turns on one phone, or create a room and send the code to a friend. You do not need to be on the same network.

BACKGAMMON TALK

When you roll double sixes, when your opponent leaves a blot, when you are waiting to enter — the game suggests what a backgammon player would say. Turn it off in settings if you would rather not.

YOUR DICE

Ten dice designs: walnut, obsidian, ruby, sapphire, emerald, ice, flame, Ottoman, cosmic, prestige. Drag with your finger and throw — the dice really bounce.

SOMETHING EVERY DAY

Daily gift, missions, invite rewards. Invite a friend and you both earn 25,000 gold.

LEADERBOARD

World ranking and country league, kept separate. See where you stand at home, or look up any other country.

LANGUAGES

Full Turkish, English and Russian. Other languages open the interface in English.

---

Gold in this game is virtual. It is not real money, cannot be exchanged for money, and is not refundable. Şeşbeş is not a gambling game; stakes are played only with in-game gold and have no monetary value.

description:
Zumazu! is a fun 'game' in the 'arcade' category that will keep you entertained for hours sitting in front of your mobile phone.

This game is not complicated, even very simple. And its simplicity is what causes addiction. In fact, this 'game' has made a lot of people addicted to it, until now there is also a mobile version.

In this game, you control a frog in the center of the screen, trying to prevent the rolling balls from reaching a hole. You have to shoot colored balls at the balls that roll in the direction of the hole. When a series of three or more balls of the same color is formed, the balls will explode. That's how you prevent the balls from reaching the hole.

Zumazu! has two game modes: First, the adventure mode where you play in various levels. The second is survival mode. In survival mode, you play as long as you can to prevent the balls from reaching the hole.

description:
Travel Board is a game where you can play in different backgrounds which are several Places, in each Place you have 3 Phases to enjoy Challenges:

First of all, you must earn the Coins Stars to have access to the Phase1.

Phase1: By clicking on the Dice, it will indicates how many steps your pawn will move, each time you reach a Code you will earn more Coins that will be used for the next phase.

Second, you have to use these Coins to buy a Transport Ticket that allows you access the Phase2.

Phase2: in this phase, your pawn will move through Numbers and the Plus Symbol, when you reach a Number, you must reach the Plus Symbol next time, and in sequence an other Number to calculate the Travelled Distance, the goal is to achieve a specific Distance needed for the next phase, each Transport you've bought before would have a Distance Bonus.

Finally, you will use this Distance to access to the Phase3.

Phase3: You will go around Letters and the Close Symbol, each time you reach a Letter you will earn the Coins Energy, if not it will decrease your earnings. These Coins will be used to access the next Place.

Have a good time playing Travel Board!!
